payload.question: Should we raise cold brew prices again?

openings.line: [no] I would not raise it again. At $5 guests already say it is not worth it and sales fell, so quality and trust are not backing a higher board price.
[strong no] I say no to another rise. Neighbours already hear $5 as too much and cold brew sales fell, so raising hurts footfall and word of mouth. Test dropping back to $4.
[strong no] I see regulars already calling $5 too much and sales dropping, so another raise will push them away for good.
[strong no] I won't raise it again. Volume fell from about 35 to about 20 a day after $5, so another hike kills throughput and margin per shift.
[strong no] I say no raise. At $5 volume fell from ~35 to ~21 a day, so cold brew cash fell from ~$140 to ~$105 daily. Raising more risks more loss; dropping to $4 likely restores cash.
